app.name: fitcher
app.tagline: Every number comes from a query you can open.

sample.tooltip: This part runs on sample data until its service is connected.
sample.unmatched: I can only answer this demo's sample questions until the chat is connected to your data. Try one of the suggested questions.

ui.composerPlaceholder: Ask a question about your data…
ui.composerHint: Answers come from read-only SQL you can open. Check numbers before you share them.
ui.stoppedText: You stopped this run before it finished. No result is shown.
ui.r_kpi: KPI needs one row with a single number
ui.r_donut_groups: Pie needs 6 or fewer non-negative groups
ui.r_donut_time: Time series can't be shown as a pie
ui.r_donut_series: Pie needs one category and one number
ui.r_line: Line needs a date or ordered axis
ui.r_grouped: Grouped bar needs two categories and one number
ui.r_bar: Bar needs a category and a number
ui.chartAria: {type} chart of {cols}. The same rows are in the data table.
ui.notePlaceholder: For example: wrong period, missing product, the number looks too high
ui.thanks: Thanks. Your note goes to the people who maintain this pack.
ui.blockedText: The question didn't pass the safety check, so nothing was queried.
ui.deniedTitle: This data isn't available to your role
ui.deniedHint: Nothing was queried. If you need this, ask an admin to review your access.
ui.oosTitle: That's outside what I can answer
ui.oosText: I answer questions about {pack} data. You could try:
ui.failedTitle: I couldn't get a valid result
ui.failedText: The query failed 3 times, so I stopped instead of guessing. Here is the last attempt and the database error.
ui.emptyText: The query ran without errors and returned 0 rows. Try a wider date range or fewer filters.
ui.networkText: The answer stopped streaming. Nothing from this run was saved.
ui.greetingSub: Ask a question about {pack} data. Every number comes from a SQL query you can open and check.
ui.chartEdited: Done. The chart above now shows a {type}. Same rows, no new query.
ui.chartEditBlocked: {type} isn't available for that result: {reason}. I kept the current chart.
ui.chartEditNone: There's no chart in this conversation yet. Ask a data question first.
ui.unreviewedMetrics: Uses metrics not reviewed by a person yet: {metrics}.
ui.proposalsNote: Questions mined from disliked or failed chats. Replace every masked value and test-run the SQL before approving.
ui.useSpec: Use this spec when the same question is asked
ui.specHelp: Pack ids only. Lists are comma-separated; one filter per line: column = value, column != value, column in a, b or column not in a, b. Periods come from the question.
ui.specInvalid: Check this part of the spec: {text}
ui.dropSub: PDF, DOCX, MD, TXT or XLSX, up to 20 MB each
ui.dropBlocked: Uploads are paused while the pack is compiling.
ui.duplicate: {name} is already uploaded. Delete the existing copy to replace it.
ui.compiling: Pack is compiling. Uploads resume when it finishes.
ui.deleteDocText: The document leaves search, and pack items that cite it get flagged for review. This can't be undone.
ui.question: Question
ui.costsNote: Estimated from token counts and list prices. Calls to free models and to a provider's free tier (such as Gemini's Flash models or Groq) count as $0, which is what a key without billing pays. The provider's invoice is the exact amount.
ui.noItemsText: Change the status filter to see more.
ui.heroTitle: What would you like to know, {name}?
ui.heroSub: Answers come from read-only SQL on {pack} data. You can open every query.
ui.exposedTitle: This address is open to other machines
ui.exposedText: fitcher has no owner password, so anyone who can reach this address controls fitcher and its data. Set a password in the console under Security, or remove the name from FITCHER_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
ui.resetPasswordNote: They are signed out everywhere and sign in again with this password.
ui.testEmpty: Run the formula against the data to preview its rows before approving.
ui.noTestText: Glossary terms and policies are checked against their evidence, not run.
ui.desc_review: Items fitcher drafted while building the pack or from documents. Approve the ones the evidence supports.
ui.desc_runs: Every question asked, with its duration and estimated cost.
ui.desc_audit: Every data access decision, newest first.
ui.deleteChatText: It is removed from your history. Runs stay in the audit log.
ui.deleteGroupText: Only the group is deleted. Its conversations move back to Recent.
ui.desc_datasets: The tables fitcher may query in the active pack. To change them, build the pack again.
ui.desc_feedback: Likes and dislikes from the chat. Turn a disliked answer into a proposal to review.
ui.desc_evaluation: The pack is turned on only when Execution match reaches the threshold.
ui.evalDone: Evaluation started; its report appears here when it finishes
ui.name: Name
ui.disableText: They can no longer sign in to fitcher. Their past runs stay in the audit log.
ui.draftConfirmText: Drafting pack items from {name} sends the document to the model gateway, which bills each call. Drafted items wait in Review until someone approves them.
ui.notFound: This item doesn't exist or was deleted.
ui.tierDesc_fast: Routing, term extraction, summaries and chart tie-breaks.
ui.tierDesc_sql_small: SQL for simple questions: one measure, at most one breakdown, one period, no comparison or top N.
ui.tierDesc_sql_gen: SQL for every other question, and the first retry after a failed simple attempt.
ui.tierDesc_embed: Vectors for search over the pack.
ui.desc_sources: The databases and files fitcher reads. Copies refresh on a schedule.
ui.heroTitleAnonymous: What would you like to know?
ui.noPackText: fitcher answers from a pack built from your own data. Connect a database or upload a file, choose its tables, then build the pack; it takes a few minutes.
ui.refusedText: fitcher refused this question before running it. Nothing from this run was saved.
ui.noPackSectionText: This page reads from the pack. Add data and build the pack, or build it again if the last build failed; both are on the Sources page.
ui.documentsAbout: Policies, handbooks and glossaries help fitcher understand what a word means. Numbers always come from your data, never from documents.
ui.documentsOffText: {n} documents stay stored but are no longer searched.
ui.documentsOffText_one: {n} document stays stored but is no longer searched.
ui.modelText: The model provider did not answer this time. It may be limiting requests, which free models do, or be out of reach. Try again in a moment, or choose another model on the Models page.
ui.chooseSource: Data source of a new conversation

setup.failed: The setup could not be saved. Try again.
setup.loadFailed: The setup could not be loaded.

models.noProviders: No provider yet. Add one so questions can be answered.
models.name: Name
models.hostHint: A model server on this computer is reached from inside the container as http://host.docker.internal:<port>.
models.paidTest: The test sends one small request to {name}, which bills it.
models.testPassed: {model} answered with structured output; {count} models listed.
models.testNoStructured: {model} did not return structured output: {reason}. It stays selectable, but answers may fail.
models.removeText: Its key is deleted from this computer. The tasks it serves move to another provider, and an embedding it served goes back to the local model.
models.embeddingLocal: Runs inside fitcher: {model}, {dimensions} dimensions. No key is needed.
models.needsReindex: The active pack was indexed with another embedding model. Compile it again before asking.
models.reindexText: The pack must be compiled again with the new model before questions use it. Search fails until then.
models.embeddingSaved: The embedding model was changed. Recompile the pack.
models.classifierOn: On: every question is also scored by the classifier, and a question stops when the classifier cannot run.
models.about_hosted: Paste a key from the provider's console. Each question is billed by the provider.
models.about_service: One key gives access to many models, often with free or low-cost ones.
models.about_local: A model server running on this computer. Nothing leaves the computer and nothing is billed.
models.about_other: Any service or server that speaks the OpenAI API, at the address it gives you.
models.openRouterFreeNote: Models whose name ends in :free cost nothing: up to 50 requests a day, or 1,000 a day once the account has bought 10 credits.

sources.manyTables: This source has {count} tables. Choose the ones the questions need: every table becomes a mart and makes the pack's draft longer.
sources.driftTitle: The pack built from this source no longer matches it:
sources.empty: No source yet. Connect a database or upload a file.
sources.name: Name
sources.nameHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Tables are read as src_<name> or copied to raw.<name>__<table>.
sources.hostHint: A database on this computer is reached from inside the container as host.docker.internal.
sources.readOnlyHint: Use a read-only user. Its password goes into ClickHouse once and is never shown again.
sources.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
sources.tls_prefer: Use TLS when the server offers it
sources.tls_verify: Require TLS and verify the server certificate
sources.caHelp: Optional. Needed to verify a server with its own certificate authority.
sources.caKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored certificate.
sources.chooseHint: Choose the tables to use and whether to read them live or copy them.
sources.reason_unreachable: The host could not be reached. Check the host name and that the network allows the connection.
sources.reason_refused: The server refused the connection. Check the port.
sources.reason_authentication: The user or password was refused. SQL Server reports an unknown database the same way.
sources.reason_tls: The TLS settings do not match the server.
sources.reason_database_not_found: The database was not found or this user may not open it.
sources.reason_permission: The user may not read the catalog or a table.
sources.reason_unknown: The connection failed for another reason.
sources.reason_interrupted: The sync was interrupted when fitcher stopped.
sources.inUse: Marts still read this source: {marts}. Remove them first.
sources.approx: Estimates from the source's own statistics.
sources.why_view: a view runs its query at the source on every read
sources.slow: Slow: joined with another live table
sources.cursorHelp: A copy that follows a column adds only rows above the last value seen; it does not see rows that were changed.
sources.deleteText: This drops its live database, its copies and its stored connection. Type the name to confirm.
sources.fileHelp: The first sheet of a workbook is read. The original is kept so the table can be reloaded.
sources.typesInferred: Column types found in {name}. Change any that are wrong before loading.
sources.sqlserverTls: The certificate of a SQL Server connection is not verified; the connection is encrypted when TLS is required.
sources.copyOnly: SQL Server tables are read through fitcher and copied only; there is no live mode.
sources.savedAndPrepared: Selection saved. The chosen tables are being prepared.

owner.signIn_throttled: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a few minutes and try again.
owner.signIn_unavailable: Signing in did not work. Try again.
owner.statusOn: An owner password is set: every browser signs in.
owner.statusOff: No owner password: fitcher answers this computer only, without signing in.
owner.exposedNeedsPassword: fitcher is open to other machines. Set an owner password on this computer before anyone else opens it.
owner.rule: At least {count} characters. A phrase of a few words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
owner.strength_fair: Strength: fair. A longer phrase, or one mixing capitals, digits and symbols, is stronger.
owner.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
owner.set: The owner password is set. This browser stays signed in.
owner.changed: Changed. Other browsers must sign in again.
owner.removeHint: Use the current password above. Once removed, fitcher answers this computer only.
owner.forgotten: If you forget the password you cannot open fitcher: the app has no way to recover it.
owner.name: Owner
owner.removeExposed: It cannot be removed while fitcher is open to other machines.
owner.forgottenConsole: If you forget the owner password you cannot open fitcher: the app has no way to recover it.

onboarding.modelTitle: Choose the model that answers questions
onboarding.modelSub: fitcher sends your questions and the structure of your tables to this model so it can write SQL.
onboarding.desc_gemini: API key from Google AI Studio
onboarding.desc_openrouter: One key for many models, some of them free
onboarding.desc_ollama: Runs on this computer, nothing is billed
onboarding.desc_other: The address the service gives you
onboarding.groupHelp_local: Nothing leaves the computer and nothing is billed.
onboarding.groupHelp_other: A service or server with the same API as OpenAI.
onboarding.keyHelp: The key is stored on this computer and never shown again.
onboarding.addressHelp: fitcher runs in Docker, so a server on this computer is at host.docker.internal.
onboarding.paidCheck: The check sends one small request to {name}, and {name} bills it.
onboarding.paidCheckOther: If the endpoint bills requests, the check sends one small billed request.
onboarding.connectedSub: fitcher chose a model for each kind of task. Change them in the console under Models.
onboarding.tierCaption: Model for each kind of task
onboarding.noStructured: {model} did not return structured output: {reason}. It still works, but some answers may fail.
onboarding.chooseSub: {name} does not suggest a model for each kind of task. The model you choose does all four; change each one later in the console under Models.
onboarding.noMatchFree: Try another word, or turn off Free models only.
onboarding.dataSub: fitcher only reads your data and never writes to it. Add more sources later in the console.
onboarding.excelNote: From an Excel file fitcher reads the first sheet. The original file is kept so it can be loaded again.
onboarding.showColumns: See the column types ({n}) and fix any wrong guess
onboarding.sourceNameHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores only.
onboarding.sqlserverCopy: SQL Server tables are copied, not read live.
onboarding.dockerHint: For a database on this computer, use host.docker.internal.
onboarding.advanced: Advanced: source name, schema, TLS, CA certificate
onboarding.caHelp: Paste the PEM certificate when the server uses its own CA.
onboarding.sqlserverTls: The SQL Server certificate is not checked; the connection is encrypted when TLS is required.
onboarding.tablesSub: Choose the tables you will ask about. Each table makes building the pack take longer.
onboarding.manyTables: This source has {count} tables. Choose only the ones your questions need; each table makes building the pack take longer.
onboarding.tablesNote: Copied tables refresh every day. Change how a table is read and how often in the console under Sources. Row counts and sizes are the database's own estimates.
onboarding.startText: The pack gets {count} analysis tables: one per table, plus some that join related tables. fitcher sends the table structure, 3 sample rows and the most common values of each column to the model, which writes descriptions, metrics and example questions. This is one call of about {tokens} tokens. The provider bills it unless the model is free or runs on this computer.
onboarding.copyFailedBanner: Copying the tables failed. Fix it in the console under Sources and build the pack there.
onboarding.modelMissing: A model is needed before the pack can be built: {reason}.
onboarding.background: Keep going in the background and open the console
onboarding.buildFailedText: {step} failed: {error}. Questions you could ask before still work.
onboarding.readySub: The pack's items are not reviewed yet; check them in the console under Review.
onboarding.tryHelp: Pick one to open the chat and ask it.
onboarding.slow: These tables are read live and may be slow; copying them is faster: {views}.
onboarding.backup: Everything lives in the data volume on this computer. Back it up; if its secret key is lost, the stored API keys cannot be read again.
onboarding.leftTitle: {n} things left before you can ask
onboarding.leftTitleOne: One thing left before you can ask
onboarding.leftSub: fitcher needs a model, your data and a pack built from that data.
onboarding.keepPassword: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
onboarding.keepCa: Leave empty to keep the stored certificate.
onboarding.nameFixed: A source name cannot change once saved.
onboarding.leftTitle_one: {n} thing left before you can ask
onboarding.startText_one: The pack gets 1 analysis table. fitcher sends the table structure, 3 sample rows and the most common values of each column to the model, which writes descriptions, metrics and example questions. This is one call of about {tokens} tokens. The provider bills it unless the model is free or runs on this computer.
onboarding.providerNameHelp: Shown in the provider list and the model picker; you can change it later.
onboarding.elapsed: Running for {time}. Building a large table can take several minutes; you can leave this page.
onboarding.screened: {done} of {total} values checked for prompt injection

instant.title: Build the pack
instant.copying: Copying the chosen tables before the pack is built…
instant.syncFailed: The copy of the chosen tables failed; fix it on the Sources page, then build the pack there.
instant.estimate: Your {datasets} tables and views become marts. Drafting their descriptions, metrics and example questions is one model call of about {tokens} prompt tokens; the provider bills it unless the model is free or runs on this computer.
instant.modelMissing: A model is needed before the pack can be drafted: {reason}
instant.failed: {step} failed: {error}. Nothing changed for the questions you could ask before.
instant.ready: Your pack is ready. Its items are marked unreviewed until someone confirms them on the Review page. Ask one of these questions:
instant.slow: These marts read live tables and may be slow; copying the tables makes them faster: {views}

overview.exposed: This address is open to other machines and has no owner password. Set one under Security.
overview.hideStart: Hide Get started on this browser
overview.passwordNote: Needed to open fitcher from another machine
overview.drifted: The pack no longer matches source {name}

sourcesPage.tablesNote: Row counts and sizes are the database's own estimates. "New rows only" adds just the rows above the last value seen; it does not see changed rows.
sourcesPage.inUse: The analysis tables {marts} still read this source. Delete them first.
sourcesPage.deleteText: This deletes the live database, the copies and the stored connection. Type the source name to confirm.
sourcesPage.driftTitle: The pack {pack} no longer matches source {name}.
sourcesPage.emptyText: Connect a database or upload a file to ask about it.
sourcesPage.readOnly: fitcher only reads your data and never writes to it.
sourcesPage.noPackText: The data is synced but the pack hasn't been built, or the last build failed. The other pages need a pack to read the data.
sourcesPage.syncFirst: Copy its data first: sync it, then choose tables.

modelsPage.emptyText: Add a provider so questions can be answered.
modelsPage.evalNote: The evaluation result is for reference and never blocks a choice.

datasetsPage.summaryNoTime: {description} Grain: {grain}. The table has no date column, so questions are answered over all its rows.

documentsPage.draftText: The document is sent to the model, which drafts terms, metrics and policies. The provider bills each call. The drafted items wait in Review until you approve them.

reviewPage.filterHelp: One filter per line: column = value, column != value, column in a, b, column not in a, b.

evaluationPage.runningText: Cases run one at a time, so this can take a few minutes.
evaluationPage.noneText: Run the evaluation to score the pack on its question set.
evaluationPage.confirmText: Every case is asked through the model, and the provider bills each call. Cases run one at a time, so this can take a few minutes.
evaluationPage.noEvalSet: This pack has no evaluation questions yet. A pack built from a source starts without them; they are added to the pack's eval.yaml with a reference date.

modelPicker.modeHelp_auto_free: Each task uses free models of every provider you added, best first, with models of other providers as fallbacks. The choice is made again when a provider or key changes and once a day.
modelPicker.modeHelp_auto_best: Each task uses the best models of every provider you added, which may be billed, with models of other providers as fallbacks. The choice is made again when a provider or key changes and once a day.
modelPicker.modeHelp_manual: Each task uses the models you chose, in your order. Choose Free models, automatic to let fitcher pick again.
modelPicker.catalogFailed: The models of {names} could not be listed; check the provider.
modelPicker.chainNote: A task asks its first model; when that model is slow, limited, out of quota or down, the next one answers.
modelPicker.does_fast: Understands the question, picks the answer type and writes the summary. Needs a fast model that answers in JSON without reasoning first; a very small one misses details of the question.
modelPicker.does_sql-small: Writes simple SQL. A small, fast model is enough.
modelPicker.does_sql-gen: Writes most SQL. Use a strong model.
modelPicker.does_sql-gen-hard: Writes SQL for hard questions and retries. Use the strongest model you have.
modelPicker.advice_quick: This task runs on every question: pick fast models that answer without reasoning first (flash, mini, 20B to 120B). The smallest models (lite, nano, 7B) often miss what the question says, such as its period.
modelPicker.advice_sql: This task writes the SQL: pick the strongest models; a higher benchmark usually means better SQL.
modelPicker.noModel: No model; add a provider or choose one.
modelPicker.title: Models for {tier}
modelPicker.chainEmpty: No model yet: add one from the list below.
modelPicker.fallback: answers if the one above fails
modelPicker.count: {shown} of {total} chat models, best for this task first
modelPicker.more: {count} more; search to narrow the list.
modelPicker.priceHelp: Price in USD per million input / output tokens
modelPicker.contextHelp: How much text the model reads at once, in tokens
modelPicker.speedHelp: Median time to answer on this computer over the last 7 days
modelPicker.jsonHelp: Known to answer in a JSON schema
modelPicker.benchmarkHelp: Artificial Analysis intelligence index: higher is better

classifier.rulesAlways: The English and Vietnamese rules check every question, even when the filter is off: a question that tries to change fitcher's instructions is stopped by them.
classifier.looking: Looking for a provider with a Prompt Guard model…
classifier.noHost: None of your providers lists a Prompt Guard model. Add Groq (free) on this page to run Llama Prompt Guard there, or run the classifier on this computer.
classifier.runsOn: On: every question is also scored by {model} on {provider}.
classifier.runsHere: On: every question is also scored on this computer.
classifier.downloadedNote: The model is on this computer (version {version}).
